claims.content: The user retrieves historic reports from the COTS reporting system based on date range and report name.

goal.raw_text: The user retrieves historic reports from the COTS reporting system based on date range and report name.

claims.content: Management
The RLCS database must contain historical transaction data and log entities (e.g., Device Command Log, System Operation Status Log) exported for reporting.
A Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) reporting tool must be configured and available to process the exported data.
Report parameters (such as date range and report name) must be defined or available for selection within the system.
The user decides to retrieve historic reports from the COTS reporting system by specifying a date range and report name.

trigger.raw_text: The user decides to retrieve historic reports from the COTS reporting system by specifying a date range and report name.

claims.content: The user accesses the Report Screen to initiate retrieval of historic reports.
The user specifies a date range and report name as parameters for the desired historical report.
The system retrieves the requested historic report from the COTS reporting system based on the specified parameters.
The system displays the retrieved report to the user via the GUI.
The requested historic report is displayed to the user via the GUI.
The retrieved report data is available for the user to print or store in a file.
